name: Literature Radar
description: An original six-screen publication-monitoring and evidence review workspace for small biotech and research teams: source-verified metadata, topics, screening, reading queues, cited synthesis and optional ChatGPT discovery.
whenToUse: Choose when scientists or translational research leads need a small internal workspace for public publication metadata, topic-scoped relevance, reading queues, reviewed evidence and optional ChatGPT literature discovery.
whenNotToUse: Do not use as a bibliometric citation network, comprehensive systematic-review registry, full text crawler or publisher-license bypass, patient/clinical data platform, independently hosted account system or live search API replacement.

heading.description: App label, not a duplicate page heading or new TrialAgents logo.

tableMap.description: Role -> real authorized typeId, physical fields and logical writableFields; JSON text.

layoutProfile.description: Reviewed native Settings profile: heading, tabs, cols and visible.

pageSize.description: Bounded records per page, clamped to 10–50.

asOf.description: Optional approved UTC date YYYY-MM-DD for dashboard cutoff, not current-time inference.

readOnly.description: Disable proposals in view-only contexts; backend authorization still governs.

demoLabel.description: Display explicit fictional/local-only warning for offline preview.

cadenceSuggestion.description: Descriptive only. Nothing is scheduled by this template.

instructions: Read the entire current TrialAgents template authoring and usage guidance using read_app_template_guidance until nextOffset is exhausted. Read app design, list_app_templates, read_app_template and pin exact digest/version before preparing. This is an internal app; use the existing TrialAgents account, DB grants, official host watermark linking to https://platform.trialagents.com. No app login, user table or independently managed email. Preserve exactly six distinct screens and one page heading plus one concise subline, no global taglines. Read/validate actual authorized schemas and configure role mappings with real saved typeIds and lowercase keys for topics, publications, matches, screenings, findings, reports and runs. Reference fields are scalar text keys storing real record IDs; status and date scalar, URL and narrative text. Include every bound field in authorized manifest with live type schema versions and read/write permissions, never copy fictional UUIDs/DOIs into production. DOI canonicalization strips resolver/doi prefix and normalizes case; PMID is numeric; do not create duplicate DOI/PMID across projects. Separate publisher metadata, topic relevance, human screening judgments and ChatGPT interpretations. Do not infer patient data, study population eligibility, paper impact, unobserved connections, citation graph, or full-text access. Only real bibliographic evidence with verified source and date may be saved. Never silently alter past topic scope decisions: bump scopeVersion for changed questions/keywords/rubrics; retain prior scope and reviewer audit history. Included and Excluded decisions must have reviewer, date, evidence rationale and a matching decision. Report Reviewed requires verified included citation record IDs in same topic, reviewer/cutoff and limitations; all ChatGPT drafts remain Draft until human reviewed. Custom frontend-js access is app-level; hiding screens or filtering topic is not authorization. Use native gear tracker:layout and declarative templateLayoutSchema with reviewed prepare_tool_layout. Screen/field drag changes only presentation data and uses expectedVersion; preserve component ID/permissions/source. Use unique data-action and data-ui-state forms. Every write is an exact records.propose requiring separate host review/receipt; duplicate drafts reset DOI/PMID or reviewer status; Delete proposes archival with archived=true, never hard-delete. On ambiguous response retry with same requestKey/reconcile receipts, never create a duplicate app/record or overwrite stale revisions. Automation is OPTIONAL. Save and reopen a usable app before automation setup. Quietly check read_automation_setup, read_app_automation_guide and list_app_automations; for accepted monitored discovery use prepare_app_monitoring via shared ChatGPT owner/workspace runner, optionally separately approved completion email via prepare_app_action. No ChatGPT task per app, no ChatGPT email sending or direct email from generated source. Stable authoringKey, scoped access, explicit source/coverage/dedup, approved save receipts; newSavedCount>0 triggers completion email only if separately approved; 0 new saves permits no_update only with complete coverage and approved quiet policy; otherwise record the required outcome. Respect disabled/archive states, current permissions, recipient limits, expiry. If no task capability or user declines use manual ChatGPT instructions; failure of setup never blocks app loading or record use. No external paid API, scraper or unlicensed full text. Host confirmations and actual scheduled runs must be tested before claiming deployment. Authoring 1.3.9 publication blockers: never declare templateConfiguration or templateBindings in catalog source. Use actual host-prepended config/bindings; no mock form field events. Mark every input/select/textarea with data-ui-state, stable action and name. Preserve form drafts and original record versions on conflict. Do not claim complete totals from unavailable, unknown-total, short-page, missing fields or >1200-row reads; paginate screens and comparison views. No paper approval or final report from incomplete evidence. Only official host watermark branding; keep complete Literature Radar name without sidebar logo. Native layout changes reflect stored order and visibility. Host end-to-end acceptance remains required.

quickStart: Open the existing TrialAgents workspace with current user identity; no app-specific login or registration. The official linked host logo points to https://platform.trialagents.com.
Read current app template guidance (authoring and usage, all pages), current design and exact version/digest. Map seven authorized record tables to stored lower-case schema fields.
Start with a saved research topic, its question/keywords/exclusions, owner, scope version and source eligibility; never seed fictional demo data.
Collect verified publication identifiers (DOI or PMID) and source provenance. Link the same publication to multiple topics using match records rather than copying metadata.
Assign screening, record reviewer/date/rationale, then save findings and synthesis only through reviewed record proposals.
Use Monitoring Setup to copy a manual ChatGPT request. Configure approved shared research/email rules in platform Automations only after app has been saved; zero automations is valid.

documentation.dataContract: Seven optional physical tables: topics (scopeVersion, keywords, owners), publications (canonical DOI/PMID, firstSeenAt, publisher metadata and verifiedAt), matches (topicId/publicationId/scopeVersion), screenings (topicId/publicationId/stage/decision/reviewer/evidence), findings (reviewed source claims), reports (citations/limitations), runs (source coverage, savedCount, outcome). All relationships are exact, authorized saved record IDs. Multiple topics can reference the same global publication record; do not clone master publication metadata. Authoritative data are only saved, committed records via manifest+grants. Unsaved form input and layout selection live in transient state; demo data are fictional and never seeded. The 1200-row-per-role guarded read budget requires indexed/backend paging beyond that range; partial reads are never authoritative. Record-level access and section isolation remain backend responsibilities; custom source is app-level access only. No publication or patient-level full text is ingested. Required physical schema (all fields scalar/multiple:false; real UUID references stored as text; source URLs and reports stored as text): topics -> name:text, question:text, keywords:text, exclude_terms:text, source_scope:text, start_year:number, owner:text, rubric:text, scope_version:number, last_checked:date, active:boolean, archived:boolean; publications -> name:text, authors:text, journal:text, published_at:date, doi:text, pmid:text, url:text, verified_at:date, first_seen_at:date, source_label:text, abstract:text, archived:boolean; matches -> name:text, topic_id:text, publication_id:text, relevance:select{Unassessed|High|Medium|Low}, rationale:text, discovered_at:date, scope_version:number, archived:boolean; screenings -> name:text, topic_id:text, publication_id:text, stage:select{New|Reading|Reviewed|Included|Excluded}, decision:select{Uncertain|Include|Exclude}, reviewer:text, due:date, reviewed_at:date, priority:select{High|Medium|Low}, rationale:text, notes:text, archived:boolean; findings -> name:text, topic_id:text, publication_id:text, claim:text, limitations:text, source:text, reviewer:text, reviewed_at:date, status:select{Draft|Reviewed}, archived:boolean; reports -> name:text, topic_id:text, cutoff:date, status:select{Draft|Reviewed}, author:text, reviewed_at:date, references:text, body:text, limitations:text, archived:boolean; runs -> name:text, topic_id:text, status:select{completed|no_update|partial|failed}, started_at:date, completed_at:date, found_count:number, saved_count:number, summary:text, source:text, archived:boolean. Missing or unauthorized fields => incomplete data, not zero. Set tableMap to a JSON string {role:{typeId:actual saved UUID,fields:{logicalKey:physical_key},writableFields:[authorized logical keys]}}. Use the complete scalar schemas in quickStart; optional blank dates/numbers are null. Create topics/publications first, use committed receipt UUIDs in child references, then findings/reports/runs. Bind every readable field with current schemaVersion/kind/mode. All fields must be mapped; arrays and inaccessible fields are incomplete. Never seed fictional data. Changing a topic scope after screening/findings exist requires a separate copied topic, so earlier decisions are not reinterpreted. Return dependent reviewed reports to Draft before altering the supporting reviewed finding or its approval. These are app guards, not cross-app database constraints. The asOf reference date does not reconstruct historical state.
documentation.interactionContract: Six source-rendered screens, one heading and one subline each, original responsive plum editorial design. Search/filter/pagination, selected paper details, role-aware record menus Edit/Duplicate/Delete, reviewed form proposals, matching/scoping, published-source provenance, screening Kanban, reviewed synthesis archive and manual ChatGPT prompt. Native host Settings gear uses tracker:layout via single-line templateLayoutSchema. Native reviewed layoutProfile reorders/hides screens/columns, no new login/auth screen. No user-facing per-app task scheduler or direct email sender. The host watermark provides official TrialAgents icon and canonical link, which is not duplicated in custom source. No anonymous external publication portal. Controls must use name, data-ui-state=true and stable data-action; real input.event.kind/action/value/form, save proposal confirmation and pending draft retention. Reading queue per-lane and run history pagination. Native layout columns follow saved profile order, not source declaration order. Findings have a paged register; Included sources is a labelled first-ten preview with the complete screening register in Reading queue. Native field ordering affects tables and editor order; other fields stay reachable in the editor. Duplicate drafts clear the original record identity and protected review state. Errors and conflicts appear inside open dialogs; proposed forms remain drafts until confirmed.
documentation.lifecycle: App is saved once under a stable ID. Exact version/digest for catalog, same component ID and requestKey/expectedVersion for corrections, no duplicate apps on retries. Every proposal needs human confirmation; stale optimistic versions and denied writes fail safely. Delete means reviewed archived:true. Shared publication cannot be archived while linked matches/screenings/findings exist. Topic scope changes bump version and require revalidation of matching; old decisions are not rewritten. Optional automation definitions are managed in TrialAgents, stable authoringKeys with separate approval; disable state survives edits, archive suspends, restore does not auto-restart; task failure never prevents app from opening. Source changes never create identity/permission grants. Archive confirmation and edit record expectedVersion are captured when the drawer opens and never upgraded at submit. Dependent record completeness is required for archive; changed verified evidence is blocked or requires re-review. Revisions create a new catalog semver rather than overwriting existing catalog entries.
limitations: Not a complete systematic review, bibliometric/citation network service, publisher crawler, licensed full-text store, EHR/clinical research record or validated regulated record system.
Public research metadata and approved notes only; a source URL is recorded text, not an automatic web fetch or guarantee of full-text permission.
No independent app accounts, SSO, signups, payments or external research APIs. Host supplies permission checks and official linked logo.
No actual unattended ChatGPT research or platform email is activated from this package. Shared runner/workspace subscription and accepted authorization must be verified separately.

The renderer reads up to 1200 rows per role. If a role is incomplete/denied, the UI explicitly withholds derived trends and totals; additional backend paging/indexing is necessary for larger catalogs.
Custom HTML app has app-level access; a filtered/hidden topic is not an isolation boundary for confidential data.
After a template is installed, production QuickJS/sanitized host tests with real manifest and reviewed writes are necessary before declaring it live.

Offline tests cover JS and Chromium; publication requires real AppTemplates loader, server QuickJS, sanitized production frame with authorized manifest, reviewed database fixtures and live host interaction. Not verified by this ZIP.

tasks.whenUseful: Manual search is fully supported without scheduling. Optionally, after the app is saved, an owner may approve weekly public-publication discovery via the shared TrialAgents ChatGPT runner, with a separately reviewed TrialAgents email only after verified new committed records.
tasks.readRequirements: Read the selected topic current scope version, keywords/excluded terms, allowed sources and all existing saved DOI/PMID identities in the owner-authorized TrialAgents app before searching. Search public metadata for papers since the approved cutoff. Verify DOI/PMID, title, journal, author and publication date against official sources; provide source URL, verifiedAt, firstSeenAt and matching rationale. Dedupe DOI/PMID globally, link existing master publication with a new topic match instead of cloning. Flag uncertain/title-only matches for review, never publish unverified metadata, full-text reproductions or inferred scientific findings. Propose only authorized new publication/match records, await exact confirmed receipts, then save a run outcome with cutoff, coverage, checked sources, new saved count and completion. No new confirmed saves permits no_update only with complete coverage and an approved quiet policy. Partial or failed coverage => report visibly and do not claim completion. Do not change previous screening, scope or reviewer decisions automatically. Only completed authorized reads and owner-approved sources qualify. Use one current topic scope revision, normalized DOI/PMID, current app grants, UTC cutoff, and evidence dates. Never treat partial coverage as no_update. Owner must verify timezone, expiry, scopes and actual trigger before activation. Stable keys: literature_discovery_v1 and literature_completion_email_v1. Reuse IDs/versions on edits. Choose owner-confirmed weekly timezone/anchor, explicit expiry and current app-bound read/write scope. Without approved standing write authority return private draft findings for manual approval; never infer a grant. Never advance cutoff on partial/failed coverage.
tasks.outputContract: Save only reviewed publication IDs, topic matches and run history to the existing authorized tables with exact request keys and receipts. Keep pending/unreviewed metadata outside authoritative counts. For complete search with zero accepted additions use no_update only if the approved quiet policy permits silence; otherwise record a completed required report. Partial/failed/denied search may not send completion email. Separate Email automation: fixed approved message, owner plus explicitly authorized TrialAgents team members only; manual after-success, not an independent schedule. No ChatGPT email. Proposed tasks are never active by template inclusion. Fixed email subject: Literature update available. Fixed body: Open https://platform.trialagents.com to review your authorized literature updates. Do not invent interpolation. Keep disabled definitions disabled; archive suspends work, restore/copy does not activate it. Delivery failure never reruns completed research. Logs show outcomes; no live readiness is implied.
tasks.promptExample: For the saved Literature Radar app, read the current authorized topic criteria and scope revision, current publication DOI/PMID index, sources and last confirmed cutoff. Search PubMed and owner-approved public metadata for recent nonclinical methods publications. Deduplicate globally by normalized DOI/PMID and by exact topicId:publicationId. Verify source URL, publication and verification dates. Propose additions and request human approval, reconcile receipts, save only an accurate source-coverage run record. Return partial on unavailable sources; do not claim no_update from incomplete coverage. Do not send external email. If asked, request separate TrialAgents owner approval for weekly research and a fixed-text completion notification under current team access.
